issues.legal_issue: A tenant who accepts possession under a mortgage in a new capacity may surrender the tenancy, so that it does not remain in abeyance or revive when the mortgage is redeemed.
material_facts: The mortgagee had occupied the property as a tenant before the mortgage arrangement.
The deed continued the tenancy only until a specified transition, after which it confirmed possession in the mortgagee’s capacity as mortgagee.
The deed authorized the mortgagee to use the property or let it to others, although the rent law then in force prohibited a tenant from subletting.
The deed contemplated the mortgagor recovering the property upon redemption, and the mortgagee’s rights thereafter were those provided by the mortgage.
issues.conclusion: The tenancy was surrendered when possession was confirmed under the mortgage arrangement; it was not merely suspended and did not revive on redemption.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 111(e) and (f) of the Transfer of Property Act, surrender may be express or implied. Implied surrender may arise from a new relationship or from relinquishment and taking of possession; physical delivery is not essential if the circumstances amount to a virtual taking of possession. Whether surrender occurred is a question of fact. The deed’s terms and the parties’ conduct showed that the tenancy ended and the relationship became that of mortgagor and mortgagee.

rule.if: mortgage_redemption_proceeding and prior_tenancy and tenancy_ended_at_transition and possession_confirmed_as_mortgagee and mortgagee_authorized_subletting and contemporaneous_tenant_law_barred_subletting and deed_contemplated_return_on_redemption

predicates.mortgage_redemption_proceeding: The dispute arose in a proceeding to redeem a mortgage and recover the property.
predicates.prior_tenancy: The person holding the mortgage had occupied the property as a tenant before the mortgage arrangement.
predicates.tenancy_ended_at_transition: The deed provided that the tenancy would continue only until a transition to possession under the mortgage.
predicates.possession_confirmed_as_mortgagee: The deed and the parties’ conduct treated the occupant’s possession after the transition as possession in the capacity of mortgagee.
predicates.mortgagee_authorized_subletting: The deed allowed the mortgagee to let the property to other occupants.
predicates.contemporaneous_tenant_law_barred_sublet: The rent law applicable at the time prohibited a tenant from subletting the property.
predicates.deed_contemplated_return_on_redemption: The deed contemplated the mortgagor recovering the property when the mortgage was redeemed.

issues.definition: When a former tenant takes possession under a mortgage on terms and conduct establishing a new mortgage relationship, the former tenancy does not revive on redemption.

issues.legal_issue: A leasehold interest and a mortgage interest in the same property do not merge merely because one person holds both interests.
material_facts: The mortgagee relied on the fact that the mortgagee had also been the tenant before the mortgage.
The lease and mortgage arose in different capacities, and neither interest was a higher or lower estate than the other.
issues.conclusion: The lease and mortgage did not merge merely because their interests were held by the same person.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 111(d) of the Transfer of Property Act, merger requires the relevant lesser and greater interests in the whole property to vest at the same time in one person in the same right, with no interest remaining outside. A lease and a mortgage do not merge merely by being held by one person because neither is, as against the other, a higher or lower estate. The Court approved Narayan v. Ramchandra, 65 Bom. L.R. 449.

rule.if: lease_and_mortgage_interests_in_same_property and same_person_holds_both_interests and interests_held_in_distinct_capacities and neither_interest_is_higher_or_lesser

predicates.lease_and_mortgage_interests_in_same_pro: The same property is subject both to a leasehold interest and to a mortgage interest.
predicates.same_person_holds_both_interests: One person holds both the leasehold interest and the mortgage interest.
predicates.interests_held_in_distinct_capacities: The person holds the two interests in different legal capacities.
predicates.neither_interest_is_higher_or_lesser: Neither the leasehold interest nor the mortgage interest is a higher or lower estate than the other.

issues.definition: When one person holds leasehold and mortgage interests in the same property in distinct capacities, and neither interest is higher or lower than the other, their unity in that person alone does not produce a merger.

issues.legal_issue: On redemption of a possessory mortgage, the mortgagor is entitled to recover actual possession when the deed provides for return of the property and the former tenancy has ended.
material_facts: The mortgagor sought redemption and possession of property held by the mortgagee under a possessory mortgage.
The mortgage deed provided for the mortgagor to redeem and recover the property, and the mortgagee’s possession was no longer under a continuing tenancy.
The mortgagor notified the mortgagee of readiness to redeem, and the courts ordered recovery of possession upon satisfaction of the amounts found due.
issues.conclusion: The mortgagor was entitled to recover actual possession upon redemption, both under the deed and under section 62 of the Transfer of Property Act.
issues.legal_principle: Section 62 of the Transfer of Property Act gives the mortgagor a right to recover possession upon redemption of a usufructuary mortgage, subject to the mortgage terms. Where the deed provides for return of the property and the former tenancy has been surrendered, the mortgagee cannot retain possession on the basis of that former tenancy.

rule.if: mortgage_redemption_proceeding and redemption_entitlement_established and deed_provides_for_return_of_property and former_tenancy_ended

predicates.mortgage_redemption_proceeding: The proceeding seeks redemption of a mortgage and recovery of the property.
predicates.redemption_entitlement_established: The mortgagor has established the right to redeem the mortgage.
predicates.deed_provides_for_return_of_property: The mortgage deed provides for the mortgagor to recover the property on redemption.
predicates.former_tenancy_ended: The mortgagee’s earlier tenancy has ended and does not continue as a basis for possession.

issues.definition: When redemption is established, the deed provides for return, and the former tenancy has ended, the mortgagor is entitled to actual possession.
